title: One prompt, ten matching images: your holiday gift guide carousel
summary: Ask for a whole set at once: a cover, eight gift slides and a closing slide, all in one look, with clear text you can still fix after.
why: Kling released Image 4.0 on November 18, 2026. Its announcement says one prompt can make up to 10 images with a matching style, render long passages of text, and let you edit the text and fonts after the image is made. We haven't seen view counts for sets like this yet; it's a new feature, so this is an early idea for December gift posts.
steps: Write your list first: 8 gift ideas, each with a name and one short line. Use your own products or real things you'd recommend.
Paste the main prompt into the image tool's set or multi-image option and fill in your list.
Check every slide for spelling and wrong details. Fix the text in the editor rather than regenerating the whole set.
Post the images as one carousel. Put the cover first and the closing slide last.

prompts.label: Main prompt: 10-slide gift guide
prompts.text: Make a set of 10 matching square images for a social media carousel called "[GUIDE TITLE, for example: Gifts for the person who's always cold]". Same style on every slide: cream background, soft warm daylight, a sprig of pine in one corner, deep green and cranberry accents, and a clean rounded sans-serif font. Slide 1 is the cover with the title in large letters. Slides 2 to 9 each show one gift on a wooden table, with its name in bold at the top and one short line under it: [LIST YOUR 8 GIFTS AND LINES]. Slide 10 says "Save this for later" with a small gift box drawing. Plain objects only, no logos or brand names on anything.

prompts.label: Variation: cosy winter kit, one item per slide
prompts.text: Create 10 images in one consistent style for a carousel called "My winter survival kit". Overhead flat-lay photos on a chunky knit blanket, soft window light, muted blues and creams. Slide 1 is a title card. Slides 2 to 9 each show one item from this list, with a short handwritten-style label: [8 ITEMS, for example: wool socks, a flask of tea, a paperback, hand cream]. Slide 10 asks "What's in yours?". Keep every slide the same angle and light. No logos or packaging text.

prompts.label: Variation for a small business: shop gift guide
prompts.text: I run [TYPE OF SHOP]. Make a set of 10 matching images for a holiday gift guide using my real products. Use the photos I've uploaded as reference and keep each product looking exactly as it does in real life: same colours, size and shape. Style: [YOUR BRAND COLOURS], simple backdrop, soft shadows, one font throughout. Slide 1: "Gift guide: [SHOP NAME]". Slides 2 to 9: one product each with its name and real price in CAD: [LIST]. Slide 10: "Shop in store or online" with [WEBSITE]. No made-up discounts, countdowns or customer quotes.

tips: Describe the shared look once, clearly. Light, background, colours and font are what make ten slides feel like one set.
Keep each slide to a few words. Small text is hard to read on a phone even if the AI spells it right.
Businesses: use real product photos as references and real prices, so the guide shows what people will actually get.
If one slide comes out wrong, fix just that one. Regenerating the whole set can change the others too.
